name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Caro-Kann goes with exactly one of Mikhail, Vera, or Discovery.
Pirc goes with at least one of Vera, Gambit, or Sacrifice.
Vera does not belong to the King's-Pawn Camp.
Boris and the player who loves the Gambit are in different camps.
